EcoWrap

EcoWrap presents a sleek, compostable paper tube lined internally with a biodegradable PLA film to ensure product integrity while allowing it to decompose naturally post-use. The outer paper is printed using eco-friendly inks and can be personalized with a unique scent or color for each variant, encouraging users to collect them all. An easy-to-grip corrugated texture on the exterior not only provides a secure hold but also minimizes slippage for smooth application.

EarthSleeve Wrapped Protection

Each deodorant is encased in a biodegradable, plant-based sleeve, elegantly wrapping around the product much like a gift. The sleeve is designed to be both protective and attractive, featuring a subtle texture that adds a tactile element to the unboxing experience. Made from sustainably sourced fibers, it ensures an eco-friendly journey from production to disposal. The surface of the sleeve can be customized with a range of patterns or messages, enhancing its appeal while promoting environmental responsibility.

EarthCycle Capsules

Capsules made from biodegradable starch-based material, each containing a single application of deodorant. The surface is textured to allow easy grip and has a plant-based label that peels off effortlessly, ensuring zero waste after use.

EcoWrap

EcoWrap introduces an innovative, plastic-free packaging solution designed specifically to enhance the appeal of natural deodorants. The core structure consists of a biodegradable cardboard container, adorned with a removable wooden lid that doubles as a convenient application tool, ensuring easy access while maintaining hygiene. The outer sleeve features a minimalist design printed with eco-friendly ink, highlighting the product's ingredients and benefits subtly yet clearly. This sustainable approach not only minimizes environmental impact but also offers a tactile, premium experience for consumers committed to green living.

Seed Pod Protection

The packaging mimics nature’s own protective seed pods, using biodegradable paper pulp as the core structure. Embedded within the soft, textured paper is a compostable inner sleeve made from bamboo fiber, which gently holds the solid deodorant bar in place. The exterior is stamped with intricate, leaf-inspired patterns, adding both aesthetic appeal and a tactile experience that aligns with the brand's commitment to the environment.
